items.prompt: The back seat of a car on a European motorway at night in the mid-1990s: a nine-year-old boy seen from behind presses his forehead to the window, watching the lights of an unfamiliar city slide past. Another child asleep beside him.

alt.ru: Заднее сиденье машины на ночном европейском шоссе середины 1990-х: мальчик лет девяти прижался лбом к стеклу и смотрит на огни чужого города.
alt.en: The back seat of a car on a European motorway at night in the mid-1990s: a boy of nine presses his forehead to the window, watching a strange city's lights.
alt.pt: O banco de trás de um carro numa autoestrada europeia à noite, meados dos anos 90: um rapaz de nove anos encosta a testa ao vidro e vê as luzes de uma cidade estranha.
alt.es: El asiento trasero de un coche en una autopista europea de noche a mediados de los noventa: un niño de nueve años apoya la frente en la ventanilla y mira las luces de una ciudad extraña.

items.prompt: A long enfilade of empty rooms in an old house, doors open one after another into the distance. In each room a single ordinary object stands alone in a pool of light: an apple, a boot, a clock, a teapot, a key. Quiet, orderly, dreamlike.

alt.ru: Анфилада пустых комнат старого дома, двери открыты одна за другой; в каждой комнате в пятне света стоит один предмет: яблоко, ботинок, часы, чайник, ключ.
alt.en: An enfilade of empty rooms in an old house, doors open one after another; in each room a single object in a pool of light: an apple, a boot, a clock, a teapot, a key.
alt.pt: Uma enfiada de salas vazias numa casa antiga, portas abertas umas após outras; em cada sala um único objeto num foco de luz: maçã, bota, relógio, bule, chave.
alt.es: Una enfilada de habitaciones vacías en una casa antigua, puertas abiertas una tras otra; en cada sala un solo objeto en un círculo de luz: manzana, bota, reloj, tetera, llave.
